1 an unsubscribe seen by one process blocks marketing in another process
2 the same person is matched regardless of letter case and surrounding spaces
3 order receipts and resets (transactional) still go to unsubscribed people
4 unsubscribes recorded at the same moment by several processes are all kept
5 a later resubscribe lifts the block for that person only
6 a resubscribe event that is older than the unsubscribe does not lift the block

2 the window slides with each message instead of resetting at a fixed time

1 free text is allowed when the patient wrote within the last 24 hours
2 free text is blocked once the patient's last message is older than 24 hours
3 an approved template is allowed outside the 24-hour window
4 a patient who has not opted in gets nothing, not even a template or an in-window text
5 free text to a patient who never wrote to us is blocked
6 different rules give different reason codes
